ActionDescriptions.CSharpClassExposureGenerator_GenerateOrU:
to generate protoscript class exposure from c sharp source
Thin wrapper over Buffaly.Development.Common.CSharpClassExposureGenerator.GenerateOrUpdateClassExposureFromCSharp(cSharpSourceText, outputFilePath, skillActionPrototypeName, sharedInitializerActionName).
	cSharpSourceText - passed directly to C# as the full source text for one public class.
	outputFilePath - passed directly to C# as the destination .pts file path to insert/update deterministically.
	skillActionPrototypeName - passed directly to C# as the base action prototype parent type in generated wrappers.
	sharedInitializerActionName - passed directly to C# as optional initializer action to call in generated wrappers.
	Returns native GenerateOrUpdateClassExposureFromCSharpResult with no ProtoScript-side validation or reshaping.
ActionDescriptions.SmartPatch_ApplyToProjectFile:
to apply a codex style update patch without codex
Thin wrapper over the core ToApplySmartPatchToProjectFile action for ProtoScript-compatible SmartPatch application.
	relativePath - existing project-relative file path to update.
	patchText - stripped-down Codex-style update-only patch document for that file.
	Returns status string text with no ProtoScript-side validation or reshaping.
ActionDescriptions.ToBuildDotNetProject:
to build a .net project
projectPath - .csproj/.sln/.slnx file path or directory containing exactly one project/solution. configuration - build configuration (defaults to Debug). timeoutSeconds - command timeout in seconds (defaults to 120). Returns concise build summary and diagnostics.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetSolutionDirectory:
to get a solution directory
solution - VisualStudioSolution instance.
ActionDescriptions.ToPublishDotNetProject:
to publish a .net project
projectPath - .csproj/.sln/.slnx file path or directory containing exactly one project/solution. configuration - defaults Release. outputPath - optional publish output directory. timeoutSeconds - defaults 120. Returns concise publish status, outputs, and diagnostics.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunDotNetTests:
to test a .net project
projectPath - .csproj/.sln/.slnx file path or directory containing exactly one project/solution. filter - optional dotnet test filter. timeoutSeconds - command timeout in seconds (defaults to 120). Returns concise pass/fail summary and failed test names.
ActionDescriptions.ToUpdateDllsForSolution:
to run update_dlls.bat for a solution
solution - VisualStudioSolution instance. Runs update_dlls.bat from ScriptDirectory (fallback: Directory\\Scripts).
ActionDescriptions.VisualStudioOntologyGenerator_SerializeS:
to serialize a solution file into a visual studio solution prototype
Thin wrapper over Buffaly.Development.Common.VisualStudioOntologyGenerator.SerializeSolutionPrototype(solutionFilePath, destinationFilePath, prototypeTokenHint).
solutionFilePath - passed directly to C#.
destinationFilePath - passed directly to C#; when empty the method returns generated prototype text without writing a file.
prototypeTokenHint - passed directly to C# as the optional deterministic token override.
Returns raw string with no ProtoScript-side validation or reshaping.
